```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)
```

# Data

```{r}
all_data <- readRDS("cleaned_survey_data.rds")

regression_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Numerical_Infl_Exp_YR   = as.numeric(as.character(Numerical_Infl_Exp_YR)),
    Categorical_Infl_Exp_YR = as.numeric(as.character(Categorical_Infl_Exp_YR)),
    age          = as.numeric(as.character(age)),
    time_decimal = year + (quarter - 1) / 4,
    time_factor  = factor(year + (quarter - 1) / 4),
    age_group    = case_when(
      age < 40              ~ "Young",
      age >= 40 & age <= 60 ~ "Middle",
      age > 60              ~ "Old",
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group))
```

# Cohort means

```{r}
cohort_data <- regression_data %>%
  group_by(time_decimal, time_factor, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    p_up        = mean(Categorical_Infl_Exp_YR %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE),
    p_down      = mean(Categorical_Infl_Exp_YR == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    pi_measured = mean(Numerical_Infl_Exp_YR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Imputation

Regress observed mean expectations on directional shares + time FE, then predict
for all cohort-period cells (including those with no observed numerical response).

```{r}
training_data <- cohort_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(pi_measured)) %>%
  mutate(time_factor = droplevels(time_factor))

if (nrow(training_data) > 10) {

  model <- lm(pi_measured ~ p_up + p_down + time_factor, data = training_data)

  cohort_data <- cohort_data %>%
    mutate(
      imputed_inflation = coef(model)["(Intercept)"] +
                          coef(model)["p_up"]   * p_up +
                          coef(model)["p_down"] * p_down
    )

} else {
  stop("Not enough training data.")
}
```

# Plot

4-quarter MA by age group, following M&N Figure 1.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_data <- cohort_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  arrange(age_group, time_decimal) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  mutate(smoothed = rollmean(imputed_inflation, k = 4, fill = NA, align = "right")) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time_decimal, y = smoothed, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Young" = "#E41A1C", "Middle" = "#377EB8", "Old" = "#4DAF4A")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1950, 2030, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Figure 1: Mean Inflation Expectations by Age Group",
    subtitle = "4-quarter moving average, imputed",
    x = "Year", y = "Expected Inflation (%)", color = "Cohort"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
